name: Dead Tide 3: Dark Cargo
source:
While in pursuit of Jessenia the Dread Pirate Queen, Gazukull and Alia find themselves aboard an old friend’s frigate. Jutta, the Privateer captain, entertains her guests in all manner; exploiting her ship’s Dark Cargo!

[From [url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-3-dark-cargo.html]Affect3D[/url]]
translation:
在追捕恐惧海盗女王杰西尼亚的过程中，加祖库尔和阿莉亚发现自己登上了一艘老朋友的护卫舰。私掠船船长朱塔以各种方式招待她的客人。利用她船上的黑暗货物！

[来自[url=https://affect3dstore.com/dead-tide-3-dark-cargo.html]Affect3D[/url]]
